Sysgration.why: Sysgration makes lithium-ion battery backup units (BBU) for AI data centers (Energy Systems line, targeted to grow revenue 3X in 2026 and reach 45-50% of a >NT$10 billion 2028 revenue target), with fully automated BBU lines in Plano, Texas serving North American AI server customers; AI data-center BBU demand drives its revenue.
Sysgration.evidence: Sysgration IR presentation: 4Q25 Investor Conference (03-10-2026): 'Plano Plant, Texas, USA: Currently the Only BBU Supplier with Localized Manufacturing in the United States'; 'AI Data Center Battery Backup Unit (BBU)'; 'First world-class customer enters trial production' (4Q25), 'First customer enters mass production' (2026).

players.product: battery backup units (BBU) for AI data centers (3kW / 5.5kW / 11kW and HVDC), incl. US-made BBU from its Plano, Texas plant

quarterly_data.signal: 4Q25 revenue NT$872.7 million, up 7.1% QoQ (3Q25: NT$815.1 million) and 14.2% YoY (4Q24: NT$764.1 million); gross margin 24.6% (3Q25: 21.3%; 4Q24: 25.7%); operating profit NT$-15.6 million (operating margin -1.8%) after NT$-37.2 million in 3Q25; non-operating income NT$49.8 million; net income attributable to the parent NT$45.8 million (net margin 5.2%; 3Q25: NT$-19.9 million); EPS NT$0.23 (4Q24: NT$0.18).
quarterly_data.figure: 4Q25 revenue NT$872.7 million (+14.2% YoY); EPS NT$0.23

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 revenue NT$3,393.9 million, up 9.1% from NT$3,109.9 million in 2024; gross margin 23.5% (2024: 24.2%); operating expenses NT$815.5 million (+16.7%); operating profit NT$-17.0 million (operating margin -0.5%) versus NT$52.9 million in 2024; net income attributable to the parent NT$52.9 million (-54.4%); EPS NT$0.27 (2024: NT$0.61). 2025 revenue by product: TPMS (tire pressure monitoring systems) 57%, industrial PCs (IPC, including drones) 23%, Energy System and Other 20%.
quarterly_data.figure: 2025 revenue NT$3,393.9 million (+9.1% YoY); EPS NT$0.27; TPMS 57% / IPC 23% / Energy System and Other 20%

quarterly_data.signal: Company view: continuous R&D investment to secure landmark customers led to a three-year decline in operating profit; as revenue scales up, profit growth is expected to outpace revenue growth. Chairman Mark Lee: 'We are willing to invest in forward-looking R&D at critical moments in order to secure a leading position in products and markets with explosive growth potential ahead of time.'

Mid-term target (company): revenue above NT$10 billion by 2028 (NT$3.4 billion in 2025), with three product lines (BBU, rugged industrial PCs, drones) each set to contribute revenue in succession by working directly with world-class customers; 2028 target revenue mix: Energy System and Other 45-50%, TPMS 25-30%, IPC 20-25%. Energy Systems is targeting 3X revenue growth in 2026; the IPC business targets 30% annual revenue growth.
quarterly_data.figure: >NT$10 billion revenue by 2028; Energy Systems 3X revenue growth targeted in 2026; IPC +30% a year

quarterly_data.signal: BBU (company): Sysgration has surpassed the UL 9540A (burn test) technical barrier, with technical strength catching up to Tier 1 manufacturers; its 3kW, 5.5kW and 11kW BBU products are expected to successively enter production between 2Q26 and 3Q26. BBU roadmap: the first world-class customer entered trial production in 4Q25; in 2026 the first customer enters mass production and new world-class customers are added; in 2027 key customers ramp up shipments with increasing order allocation; the company aims to become the world's third-largest BBU manufacturer by 2028 (the deck places Panasonic, with self-made cells and modules, in Tier 1).
quarterly_data.figure: 3kW, 5.5kW and 11kW BBUs into production between 2Q26 and 3Q26; global #3 BBU maker targeted by 2028

quarterly_data.signal: Plano, Texas plant (company): spans 100,000 square feet with flexible capacity for TPMS, industrial PCs and BBUs; its fully automated production lines (extensive robotic arms, only 3-5 operators per line; capacity can be expanded to up to eight automated lines) commence gradual mass production from 1Q26, and the plant commences BBU mass production and shipments in 2026 across 11KW, 5.5KW, 3KW and HVDC specifications; the first fully automated BBU line at the U.S. plant was expected to complete installation in 1Q26, followed by revenue contributions. Located near the Taiwanese server supply-chain cluster in Texas, it shortens product lead times from 5-6 weeks to 2-3 weeks for North American AI server customers. Company claims: currently the only BBU supplier with localized manufacturing in the United States, and an industry-first fully automated BBU production line.
quarterly_data.figure: 100,000 square feet; 3-5 operators per line, up to eight automated lines; lead time 5-6 weeks cut to 2-3 weeks

quarterly_data.signal: Plano capacity ramp plan (company): facility and equipment build-up in 2024-2025; TPMS production line +1, SMT production line +2, BBU production line +2 and IPC production line +1 in 2026; BBU production line +1~2 and IPC production line +1 in 2027. Products shown for the plant: data-center BBU, LIB packs for UPS, SMR battery packs, TPMS, PCBA for AI servers, drones, IPC, automotive ECU / BCM, AR head-mounted devices (HMD) and autonomous mobile robots (AMR).
quarterly_data.figure: 2026: BBU production line +2; 2027: BBU production line +1~2

quarterly_data.signal: Manufacturing footprint (company): four facilities - Zhenjiang, Jiangsu, China (UPS LIB packs, BBU); Huizhou, Guangdong, China (TPMS); Nangang, Nantou, Taiwan (TPMS, BBU, IPC); Plano, Texas, USA (TPMS, BBU, drones; launching in 1Q26); headquarters in Neihu, Taipei (operations management, sales, R&D). Three major product lines: tire pressure monitoring systems (TPMS), industrial PCs (including drones) and Energy Systems (Power Tank Energy).

Energy Systems portfolio (company: over a decade of experience in high-voltage lithium-ion battery packs with a proven shipment track record): AI data-center BBUs - HV BBU (NCA) 234V / 6kW with 30min backup, HV BBU (NCA) 189V / 11kW with 120sec backup, HP BBU (NCA) 50.4V / 8.8kW with 90sec backup; battery packs / racks for UPS at semiconductor and high-tech companies (proven track record of shipments to leading semiconductor companies) - 25.6V modules at 17.9kW (7C) and 10.2kW (4C), 512V cabinets at 358.4kW (7C, <15min backup) and 204.8kW (4C, 15~30min backup); 4G/5G base-station switching mode rectifier (SMR) modules (LFP 51.2V / 5.12kW; NCA 46.8V / 2.56kW; 60min backup); AMR (48V / 50Ah) and e-bike (36V / 48V, 15-20Ah) battery packs.

Pegatron acquired a 9.6% stake in Sysgration through a private placement in February 2026, becoming a key strategic shareholder. Targeting AI server 'Made in USA' opportunities, both companies are integrating resources, with U.S. production and shipments starting in 2H26. The collaboration covers three synergies: joint procurement of key materials and components (room for gross-margin improvement); integrating both parties' manufacturing resources for 'Made in USA' AI infrastructure, with localized engineering support close to cloud service provider (CSP) customers; and complementary sales (cross-referring customers).
quarterly_data.figure: 9.6% stake (February 2026); U.S. production and shipments starting in 2H26
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: strategic shareholder and 'Made in USA' AI server manufacturing partner

quarterly_data.signal: Strategic investment in Celxpert (company): the two divide tasks with complementary resources - Sysgration on high-power industrial BBU and data-center CSP customers, Celxpert on consumer electronics (laptops, power tools, small modules); the partnership strengthens cell procurement synergies and customer cross-referrals, and through the alliance Sysgration has already received customer inquiries related to drone batteries.
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: strategic investment and battery alliance partner

quarterly_data.signal: Industrial PC (company): IPC single-month revenue exceeded NT$100 million in late 2025 (5X YoY growth) after new rugged IPC products for special vehicles (such as agricultural machinery and construction vehicles) and large-scale land surveying entered production in 3Q25; the business focuses on high-margin, long-lifecycle (5-7 years) niche projects with single-project monthly shipments of 500 to 1,000 units and a development cycle of approximately two years per project.
quarterly_data.figure: IPC single-month revenue >NT$100 million in late 2025 (5X YoY)

quarterly_data.signal: Sysgration's rugged mobile devices (point of care, rugged notebook, patient infotainment, tablet PC, PDA) primarily adopt Qualcomm platforms for low power consumption, energy efficiency and integrated communication; company: Qualcomm platforms have high entry barriers, and Sysgration stands out with its self-developed computing core.

Drones (company): Sysgration has acted as a distributor for Quantum Systems products since 4Q25; under the partnership it is responsible for exclusive sales, manufacturing, joint procurement, product lifecycle support and maintenance training for the entire Quantum Systems product line (including short-, medium- and long-range AI ISR drones) in Taiwan, promoting localized manufacturing of uncrewed aerial systems (UAS); it has achieved 100% MIT (Made in Taiwan) localized manufacturing for drones and is successively receiving customer inquiries; ground control station (GCS) products are expected to ramp up in 2H26.
quarterly_data.figure: GCS products ramp up in 2H26; 100% MIT drone manufacturing
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: drone maker; Sysgration is its exclusive Taiwan sales, manufacturing and support partner
